# G-09: the test files a tenant-migration change must run.
#
# One repo-relative test path per line, sorted. The list is the reviewed expectation of the
# migration impact runner (test/support/migration_impact.ex): the manifest-position pins, the
# tenant table oracle comparisons and the manifest replay / existing-row cases.
#
# scripts/ci_select_tests.py reads this list and makes every file MANDATORY when a migration
# path changes (a file that does not fit the CI budget fails the run closed instead of being
# deferred to the nightly). The probe (test/letflow/security_probe/g09_migration_impact_test.exs)
# re-derives the same set from the tree and fails when this list and the tree disagree.
